relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of the NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome contributes to neuropathic pain and may represent a novel target for pain therapeutic development.

relationships.subject: microRNAs
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, we emphasize the effects of microRNAs as another regulator of NLRP3 inflammasome.

key_findings: Review of NLRP3 inflammasome roles in peripheral neuropathic pain via neuroinflammation, apoptosis, pyroptosis, cytokine release, mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress.
miRNAs are highlighted as regulators of NLRP3.
